Adds shared assistant-visible-text sanitization to the Nostr outbound adapter and direct inbound-DM reply callback, suppresses sanitized-empty replies, and adds focused regressions.

PR surface: Source +10, Tests +89. Total +99 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current Nostr delivery has an adapter path without sanitizeText and a direct callback that bypasses the adapter, while the submitted runtime harness demonstrates the corrected output. A credentialed live-relay pre-fix reproduction was not run.

target.title: fix(nostr): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Nostr direct messages could expose internal assistant tool-failure banners and tool-call XML instead of sending only user-visible reply text.

Related: #90684

## Why This Change Was Made

Nostr now opts into the shared assistant-visible-text sanitizer through the standard outbound adapter hook. Its inbound DM reply callback also applies the same sanitizer because that callback delivers directly through the Nostr bus and bypasses the core outbound adapter pipeline.

The narrowed Nostr adapter type requires the sanitizer hook, so a later adapter refactor cannot silently drop this delivery invariant while still type-checking. Trace-only inbound replies are suppressed before Markdown conversion and relay delivery.

## User Impact

Nostr recipients see the intended assistant response without internal tool traces or XML scaffolding. Ordinary prose remains unchanged, and a reply containing only internal trace content does not produce an empty DM.

## Evidence

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Nostr outbound delivery and the direct inbound-DM reply callback could publish internal tool-trace banners or tool XML because neither path applied the shared assistant-visible-text sanitizer.
- **Real environment tested:** Linux x86_64, Node 24.14, original branch `fix/nostr-outbound-tool-trace-sanitize`, exact head `08cbd5bb265f141dfd45a6329a5373bc90cf73d7`, rebased onto `upstream/main` `35fb5ee81ac6d0caedf624171d755957b8911543`.
- **Exact steps or command run:** `node --import tsx` with a runtime harness importing `nostrOutboundAdapter` from `extensions/nostr/src/gateway.ts` and invoking its actual `sanitizeText` hook for mixed, XML, ordinary, and trace-only payloads.
- **Evidence after fix:** Terminal capture of the `node` runtime verification (copied live output):

  ```text
  mixed: PASS output="Done."
  xml: PASS output="DM delivered."
  ordinary: PASS output="The relay has 2 active subscriptions."
  trace-only: PASS output=""
  ALL PASS
  ```

- **Observed result after fix:** Mixed visible/trace content retains only visible prose, tool-call XML is removed, ordinary prose is unchanged, and trace-only content becomes empty. The committed inbound gateway regressions additionally prove that mixed replies reach the relay callback as sanitized text and trace-only replies call neither Markdown conversion nor the reply callback.
- **What was not tested:** A live public Nostr relay round trip. The actual adapter and inbound gateway callbacks were exercised without relay credentials. The complete local Nostr suite's SQLite-backed cases require Node 24.15+ because Node 24.14 embeds an unsafe SQLite version; exact-head CI runs on the supported runtime.

### Tests and checks

```text
OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/nostr/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts \
  extensions/nostr/src/channel.inbound.test.ts \
  extensions/nostr/src/channel.outbound.test.ts

Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests       11 passed (11)
```

```text
OPENCLAW_LOCALE=en OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 \
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/nostr/src/channel.test.ts

Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       37 passed (37)
```

Additional checks completed successfully:

- extensions production and test `tsgo` lanes
- scoped `oxfmt` and `oxlint`
- conflict-marker check
- runtime import-cycle check: 0 cycles
- `git diff --check`
